caveat: Rendering is SwiftShader (CPU rasterisation in headless Chromium), so absolute frame times are not a GPU device's. The comparison between pages measured under the same conditions is what this measures.
interleaved: within each mode, one run of each page in turn, a new browser process per run
pooled: sweeps 2 and 3 pooled (both with the heartbeat stall measure); host load 21-38

sweep1_quiet_host.note: medians (median,min,max) transcribed from the run log; raw JSON overwritten; no heartbeat in that sweep
